services.desc: Blueberry Hill offers several Golf & Lodging Packages throughout the season. Along with the golf, the area holds several other attractions. Just 4 miles from our golf course lies the beautiful Kinzua Dam with boating, fishing, and swimming. The Salamanca Casino is just a 30-minute drive, and the Allegany National Forest offers hiking, biking, and ATV trails. Experience peaceful lodging near Kinzua Dam with beautiful accommodations and easy access to Blueberry Hill Golf
